content:
**Melvin "Million Manhoef" Manhoef** is a Surinamese-Dutch professional mixed martial artist (MMA) and kickboxer known for his explosive knockout power, aggressive fighting style, and longevity in combat sports. Here’s a comprehensive breakdown of his career and life:

---

### **📌 Basic Information**
- **Full Name:** Melvin Manhoef
- **Nickname:** *Million Manhoef* (earned due to his knockout power and high-octane style)
- **Born:** May 11, 1976
- **Nationality:** Surinamese-Dutch
- **Height:** 5'10" (178 cm)
- **Weight Class:** Middleweight (185 lbs / 84 kg), Light Heavyweight (205 lbs / 93 kg)
- **Discipline:** MMA, Kickboxing
- **Team:** *Manhoef Gym (Netherlands), Blackzilians (formerly), Glory Sports International*
- **Record (MMA):**
  - **Wins:** 32 (25 by KO/TKO)
  - **Losses:** 18 (6 by KO/TKO)
  - **Draws:** 0
  - **No Contests:** 2
- **Record (Kickboxing):** 64 wins (44 KO), 26 losses, 0 draws

---

---

### **🥊 Combat Sports Career**
#### **🔹 Kickboxing Career (Early Years)**
- Manhoef began training in **kickboxing** at a young age in the Netherlands, inspired by Surinamese-Dutch fighters like **Lucy van Dam** and **Ivan Hipolito**.
- He competed in **It’s Showtime**, **K-1**, and **Glory**, becoming known for his **devastating right hand** and liver punches.
- **Notable Kickboxing Achievements:**
  - **It’s Showtime 70 kg World Champion** (2006)
  - **WMC Muay Thai World Champion**
  - Fought top names like **Buakaw Banchamek (Sombat Banchamek)**, **Artem Levin**, **Joe Schilling**, and **Simon Marcus**.
  - Known for his **aggressive, brawling style** with a strong focus on punches (uncommon in traditional Dutch kickboxing, which emphasizes kicks).

#### **🔹 MMA Career**
Manhoef transitioned to MMA later in his career but quickly made an impact with his **striking-heavy** approach.

- **Debut:** 2008 (at age 32)
- **Promotions Fought In:**
  - **Bellator MMA** (2015–2020, 2022)
  - **ONE Championship** (2011–2014)
  - **DREAM** (2008–2009)
  - **Strikeforce** (2010)
  - **Rizin FF** (2016–2017)
  - **Other:** Cage Warriors, KSW, Hardcore MMA, etc.

##### **🏆 Notable MMA Fights & Achievements**
| **Opponent** | **Result** | **Event** | **Method** | **Notes** |
|-------------|-----------|-----------|------------|-----------|
| **Mark Hunt** | Loss (TKO, R1) | DREAM.6 (2008) | Punches | Freakish upset; Hunt was a PRIDE legend |
| **Kazushi Sakuraba** | Win (TKO, R1) | DREAM.9 (2009) | Punches | Knocked out the Japanese legend |
| **Rory MacDonald** | Loss (Sub, R1) | UFC Fight Night (2010) | Rear-Naked Choke | Only UFC fight (submitted by future title challenger) |
| **Brock Larson** | Loss (Sub, R1) | Strikeforce (2010) | Rear-Naked Choke | Struggled with grapplers early in MMA |
| **Roger Gracie** | Loss (Sub, R2) | ONE FC (2011) | Arm Triangle | Submitted by BJJ legend |
| **Doug Marshall** | Win (KO, R1) | Bellator 135 (2015) | Punch | Bellator Middleweight Tournament |
| **Hisaki Kato** | Loss (TKO, R2) | Bellator 152 (2016) | Head Kick | Having success before being finished |
| **Rafael Carvalho** | Loss (UD) | Bellator 182 (2017) | Decision | Fought for Bellator MW Title |
| **Yuki Kondō** | Win (KO, R1) | Rizin FF (2016) | Punches | One of his most brutal KOs |
| **Mamed Khalidov** | Loss (TKO, R1) | KSW 43 (2018) | Punches | Fought in Poland |
| **Yatto Djamaludin** | Win (KO, R1) | ONE Championship (2011) | Punch | Quick finish |
| **Denis Tiulenov** | Win (TKO, R1) | Rizin 31 (2021) | Punches | Still finishing fights at 45 |

##### **💥 Fighting Style**
- **Striking:** Devastating **right hand**, liver hooks, and overhand rights. Uses a **high-guard, brawling style** with little footwork but incredible power.
- **Grappling:** Initially weak (submitted multiple times early in MMA), but improved his **wrestling and takedown defense** later in his career.
- **Chin:** Iron jaw—rarely gets knocked out cleanly (only 6 KO losses in 50+ fights).
- **Cardio:** Struggles in later rounds but makes up for it with **explosive early-round power**.

---

### **🏆 Titles & Accomplishments**
- **It’s Showtime 70 kg World Champion** (2006, Kickboxing)
- **WMC Muay Thai World Champion**
- **Bellator Middleweight Tournament Finalist** (2015)
- **ONE FC Middleweight Tournament Runner-Up** (2012)
- **Multiple-time KO of the Night/Year** (Rizin, Bellator, ONE)
- **Oldest Fighter to Win in Bellator** (45 years old vs. Denilson Neves in 2022)

---

### **🎤 Personality & Public Image**
- **Charismatic & Outspoken:** Known for his **trash-talking**, confidence, and entertaining interviews.
- **Catchphrases:**
  - *"I’m a million-dollar man!"* (hence the nickname)
  - *"I’m gonna break his face!"*
  - *"I don’t look for points, I look for knockouts!"*
- **Fan Favorite:** Beloved for his **never-back-down attitude** and willingness to fight anyone, regardless of size or skill.
- **Rivalries:**
  - **Joe Schilling** (kickboxing/MMA, split decisions)
  - **Hisaki Kato** (Bellator rivalry)
  - **Dhiego Lima** (Bellator 2019, controversial win via spinning back fist)

---
---
### **💰 Net Worth & Earnings**
- Estimated **net worth: ~$1–2 million** (from fight purses, sponsorships, and gym ownership).
- **Highest Payday:** Likely **Rizin FF** or **Bellator** main events (reportedly earned **$50K–$100K per fight** in later years).
- **Sponsorships:** Reebok, Fairtex, and various Dutch/Surinamese brands.

---
---
### **🏋️ Training & Gym**
- **Manhoef Gym (Rotterdam, Netherlands):** His own gym where he trains fighters in **striking and MMA**.
- **Training Partners:**
  - **Gegard Mousasi** (former Strikeforce & Bellator champion)
  - **S Raoul Maropa** (kickboxer)
  - **Other Dutch Surrey fighters** (Surinamese-Dutch community is strong in combat sports).

---
---
### **🌍 Outside the Cage**
- **Early Life:** Born in **Paramaribo, Suriname**, moved to the **Netherlands** as a child.
- **Family:** Married, has children. Keeps his personal life private.
- **Business Ventures:**
  - Owns **Manhoef Gym**.
  - Has done **seminars** and **fight commentaries**.
- **Social Media:**
  - **Instagram:** [@millionmanhoef](https://www.instagram.com/millionmanhoef/) (100K+ followers)
  - **YouTube:** Posts training clips and vlogs.

---
---
### **🎥 Highlights & Must-Watch Fights**
1. **Manhoef vs. Mark Hunt (DREAM.6, 2008)** – [YouTube Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...) *(Shocking upset over PRIDE legend)*
2. **Manhoef vs. Kuzushi Sakuraba (DREAM.9, 2009)** – [YouTube Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...) *(KO over Japanese legend)*
3. **Manhoef vs. Yuki Kondo (Rizin FF, 2016)** – [YouTube Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...) *(Brutal KO with a right hand)*
4. **Manhoef vs. Joe Schilling (Bellator Kickboxing, 2016)** – [YouTube Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...) *(Epic brawl)*
5. **Manhoef vs. Doug Marshall (Bellator 135, 2015)** – [YouTube Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...) *(KO win in tournament)*

---
---
### **🔮 Legacy & Future**
- **Pioneer for Surinamese Fighters:** Inspired a generation of **Dutch-Surinamese fighters** (e.g., Tyrone Spong, murthel Groenhart).
- **Longevity:** Fought at a **high level into his 40s**, with knockouts over younger opponents.
- **Retirement:** Officially **retired in 2023** after a loss to **Fabio Maldaner** at **Bellator 291** (age 46).
- **Post-Retirement:** Likely to stay involved in **coaching, commentating, and endorsements**.

---
---
### **📝 Fun Facts**
✅ **Oldest KO in Bellator History** (45 years, 326 days vs. Denilson Neves in 2022).
✅ **Never Tap to Strikes** – All his submission losses were via **chokes or armbars**, never from strikes.
✅ **Fought in 4 Decades** (2000s–2020s) across **kickboxing and MMA**.
✅ **Surinamese Heritage:** Represents **Suriname** in international competition.
✅ **Nickname Origin:** "Million" comes from his **million-dollar smile** and **big personality**, not just his power.

---
---

---
### **💬 Famous Quotes by Manhoef**
> *"I don’t care about the money, I care about the belt. But if the money is right, I don’t care about the belt!"*

> *"I’m not here to dance, I’m here to fight!"*

> *"A lot of guys talk, but I walk the walk."*

> *"I’m like a fine wine—I get better with age!"*

---
---
### **🎤 Final Thoughts**
Melvin Manhoef is a **true warrior** of combat sports—a **striking savant** who defied age and expectations. While he never became a **world champion in MMA**, his **knockout power, entertainment value, and resilience** made him a **fan favorite worldwide**. His legacy as one of the **toughest and most exciting fighters** in both kickboxing and MMA is secure.
